title: National Movement In Light Of First World War
definition: The period (1914-1918) marked a paradigm shift in the Indian National Movement, characterized by the transition from moderate constitutional agitation to mass mobilization, fueled by wartime economic distress and global political shifts.
importanceInUpsc: This period serves as the bridge between the 'Moderate-Extremist' era and the 'Gandhian' era, frequently tested for its impact on revolutionary activities, constitutional reforms, and the rise of mass nationalism.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of National Movement In Light Of First World War.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
